independence: Own 90-step scalar fee bisection, breadth-first action bitmasks and terminal path enumeration; no reviewed step/fee/evaluate/Pareto/mixture helper used
scope: Finite synthetic iid support, deterministic nonanticipating full-history policy trees; this class can exceed financial-state-only deterministic Markov policies
observations: Initial real peak plus annual endpoints only; fees are included in endpoint wealth; no fee-only observation or terminal liquidation

numerical_semantics.budget: Requested/effective numerical chance budgets are separately recorded; comparisons use the same effective budget, without claiming exact requested-alpha feasibility

non_guarantees: No market model calibration or policy selection
No population or real-market risk certificate
No general floating-point, approximation or policy-error bound
Root randomization is a mathematical relaxation, not a deployed advice policy

solver_metadata.scope: Fully enumerated short history-tree reference under supplied finite iid model
solver_metadata.g: Expected total log(real terminal wealth / real current wealth), not annualized
solver_metadata.q: Probability of any annual-endpoint MDD-L>1e-12, including already-latched breach
solver_metadata.root_feasibility: q <= effective_alpha; alpha=0 permits only exactly zero computed q
solver_metadata.probability_guard_meaning: 64*float64 epsilon absolute numerical convention, not a proved total rounding-error bound or a statistical risk margin; relative budget expansion may be substantial near zero
solver_metadata.mixture_dual_scope: Primal/dual agreement is for effective_alpha; this only gives a looser upper bound at requested_alpha, not strict original-budget feasibility or original-problem strong duality
solver_metadata.on_breach_meaning: Continue the same two actions; the breach flag remains absorbing
solver_metadata.policy_class: Deterministic nonanticipating full-history trees; conditional budgets are implicit in branch choices
solver_metadata.pruning: Exact weak dominance in q and g, with at least one strict inequality; exact duplicates keep a canonical policy
solver_metadata.peak_observations: Initial point and annual endpoints; no extra intraperiod fee-only observation or terminal liquidation
solver_metadata.randomized_bound: Convex relaxation of finite whole-policy root pairs; not deployable randomized advice
solver_metadata.observable_support: Duplicate positive-probability joint (gross,inflation) rows are rejected, so invisible labels cannot serve as random coins
